tutorial_body_1: A Wheel of Fortune-style party game. Your phone runs everything - the TV just shows the puzzle board for everyone to see.
tutorial_body_2: Add 2 to 6 teams and pick a category. Teams take turns spinning and guessing - the phone tracks whose turn it is automatically.
tutorial_body_3: Tap the wheel to spin. Land on a dollar value to guess a letter for that much per occurrence. Watch out for Bankrupt (loses all your money) and Lose a Turn.
tutorial_body_4: Consonants are free with a spin. Vowels cost $250 each, paid from your team's earnings - but they're often worth it to crack the puzzle.
tutorial_body_5: Any team can attempt to solve the puzzle at any point during their turn. Guess wrong and play passes to the next team.
tutorial_body_6: Land on this and every letter you guess pays a normal per-letter rate - but if your team solves the puzzle before the round ends, you win a flat $1,000,000 bonus on top.
tutorial_body_7: Play three regular rounds, then the highest-earning team enters the Bonus Round: pick a category, spin a separate prize wheel, and solve against a 10-second clock for a sealed cash prize.
tutorial_body_8: Pair with your TV, set up your teams, and start playing. Good luck!
